title: start + length overflows mrb_int, both guards go false, and fill writes far past the element buffer
live_proof: upstream fixed it in ec89364c4 (ec89364c44d74387a85d814c938201f0a477974c) (2026-08-01), which is in master and postdates the 4.0.0-rc2 pin (2026-03-12); the pin's tree has no such fix. Host ASan at the pin: no report (with MRB_HEAP_PAGE_SIZE=1: no report); the same case on master: no report
fidelity: the trigger is the Ruby test upstream added with its fix, extracted onto a self-contained harness that collects failures instead of aborting, so one script yields one verdict.
